","rawrt.heading":"FAQs","rawrt.items":[{"id":"first","question":"What is Roku?","answer":"<p>Roku is a streaming platform that connects your TV to the apps and channels you want to watch.</p>  <p>Here's how Roku works:</p>  <ul>   <li><strong style=\"margin-right: 4px;\">Hardware options:</strong> <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/products/players\">Roku streaming players</a> plug into any TV with an HDMI port; <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv\">Roku TV</a> comes in two forms: TVs made by Roku, and smart TVs from partner brands like TCL, Hisense, and Philips with Roku's OS.</li>   <li><strong>All your apps in one place:</strong> Both give you access to Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, The Roku Channel, and thousands of other apps from a single home screen. Subscriptions may be required for some apps. </li>   <li><strong>Simple by design:</strong> All Roku devices come with voice search, a single home screen, and automatic software updates.</li> </ul>"},{"id":"second","question":"Is Roku free? How much does it cost?","answer":"<p>   Once you own a device, the Roku platform itself is free to use; there's no subscription fee.   <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/products/players\">Streaming players</a> and   <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv\">Roku TV models</a> are available at a range of price points to fit your budget. </p> <p><strong>Once you're set up, here's what you get:</strong></p> <ul>   <li>     <strong style=\"margin-right: 5px;\">Free content included:</strong>     <a href=\"https://therokuchannel.roku.com/\">The Roku Channel</a> comes free with your device, with live TV, movies, and on-demand content. No subscription needed.   </li>   <li>     <strong>Third-party services, your choice:</strong>     Add paid streaming services like Netflix, Hulu, or Prime Video if you want them. Roku doesn't add any fees on top of what those services charge.   </li>   <li>     <strong>No lock-in:</strong>     No contracts or cancellation fees from Roku. Add or remove any streaming service whenever you like.   </li> </ul>"},{"id":"third","question":"What can you watch on Roku? ","answer":"<p> Roku gives you access to thousands of streaming apps and 500+ free TV channels with live TV. </p> <p>Here's what's available:</p> <ul> <li> <strong style=\"margin-right: 5px;\">Free content:</strong> <a href=\"https://therokuchannel.roku.com/\">The Roku Channel</a> gives you live news, movies, shows, sports, kids' TV, and Roku Originals at no charge. No subscription required. </li> <li> <strong>Top paid services:</strong> Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max, Prime Video, Disney+, and Apple TV+ are all available in the Roku Channel Store. </li> <li> <strong style=\"margin-right: 5px;\">Free live TV:</strong> <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/whats-on/live-tv\">Live TV</a> is also free, including local news, weather, and <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/whats-on/stream-live-sports\">live sports</a>. </li> <li> <strong>Cable TV:</strong> Cable subscribers can download their provider's app and watch cable channels on Roku at no extra cost. </li> </ul>"},{"id":"fourth","question":"How do I start streaming on Roku?","answer":"<p>Most setups take under five minutes. No cable subscription required, no contracts. </p>  <p>Here's what you need and how to get started:</p>  <ul>   <li>     <strong>What you'll need:</strong>     A TV with an HDMI port, a Wi-Fi connection, and a  <a href=\"https://www.roku.com/products/players\">Roku streaming player</a>.   </li>   <li>     <strong>Connect and power on:</strong>     Plug the player into your TV's HDMI port and power it on.   </li>   <li>     <strong>Complete setup:</strong>     Follow the on-screen steps to connect to Wi-Fi and create a free     <a href=\"https://my.roku.com/signup\">Roku account</a>.   </li>   <li>     <strong>Have a Roku TV?:</strong>     Skip the HDMI step.
